03 / About us

A space for
considered choices.

Named for the Japanese tokonoma—an alcove devoted to the thoughtful placement of art and objects—Tokonoma Journal is an independent editorial project for curious people.

Our interests move between Japan and the wider world: culture, work, design, gifts, and useful discoveries. Not everything needs to be new. Not everything needs to be bought. What matters is that it deserves your attention.

We are building our first product guides. Recommendations and shopping links will appear here as they are selected and verified.

Affiliate & editorial disclosure

Some future links on this site may be affiliate links, which means we may earn a commission from qualifying purchases at no additional cost to you. We will clearly identify affiliate recommendations when they are added. We do not currently present any product as independently tested unless expressly stated.

For now, this site contains no Amazon affiliate links. Product availability and pricing should always be confirmed with the retailer.
